findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Report a problem with Channel3's results or tools to the Channel3 team, such as wrong product data, an error, or slow responses. Include the product IDs and wha…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.trychannel3.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_products · Private data: submit_feedback · Public sink: search_products, submit_product_review, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_products · Private data: submit_feedback · Public sink: search_products, submit_product_review, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
